description: Air-cooled room, CRAH units on a classic chilled water plant
notes: Supply/return = chilled water loop. Return derived from supply plus the typical 5 to 6 C delta T. Heat is low grade: needs a heat pump for almost any reuse.

description: Air-cooled room, CRAH on an elevated-temperature chilled water plant
notes: Supply from SE (18 to 20 C elevated). Return derived with the about 10 C delta T SE gives for elevated plants. Modern colocation default.

description: Direct or indirect outside air with evaporative assist (hyperscale, cool and dry climates)
notes: No facility water loop at the rack: supply/return are empty on purpose. Heat leaves as exhaust air; recovery needs air-to-water coils (as in Meta Odense) plus a heat pump. Exhaust range from DOE return air figures.

description: Air-cooled servers with rear door heat exchangers (RDHx) on facility water
notes: RDHx captures nearly all rack heat into water but at low temperature (water must stay below server exhaust air). Rack kW from SemiAnalysis (30 to 40 kW). Temperatures are a team assumption.

description: Direct-to-chip cold plates for Hopper class (H100/H200, about 700 W), remainder via RDHx or air
notes: Supply: DCD says 700 W chips may need water as low as 27 C, Meta supplies 30 C. Liquid share and return (delta T about 8 C) are team assumptions.

description: Rack-scale direct-to-chip liquid cooling for Blackwell (GB200/GB300 NVL72, B200/B300)
notes: Blackwell lead-in water up to 40 C (LiquidStack via Compass); some GB200 builds designed for 44 C; QCT spec max inlet 45 C, max return 65 C. Typical deployments run nearer 32 C (DCD: industry converging on 32 C). 90% to liquid per Lenovo. Typical return assumes about 10 C delta T.

description: Warm-water 100% liquid cooling for Vera Rubin (NVL144 class), chiller-free in most climates
notes: NVIDIA: up to 45 C in, exits chip at roughly 55 C, 100% liquid at rack level. Facility share below 1 because storage, network and CPU-only halls stay air-cooled (Compass designs 80/20). Return at facility level assumed equal to chip outlet minus mixing losses.

description: Google TPU pods, direct liquid cooling (since TPU v3, 2018)
notes: Google confirms liquid cooling at GW scale but publishes no temperatures. Temperatures copied from dlc_warm as a team assumption.
